# GHOST media object vectors (Phase 11 design faza11-media.md §3, §4.1, §6.4; §3.9, §15.2 item 1).
# Generated and checked by client-core/media/tests/vectors.rs (GHOST_WRITE_VECTORS=1 rewrites it);
# replayed independently by android/media/src/test/kotlin/org/ghost/media/vectors/MediaVectorReplayTest.kt.
#
# Byte recipes: `hex:<hex>`, `golden:<path under media-goldens/media3-1.11.1/>[a..b]` (a slice of a
# committed golden; either bound may be empty), `+` between parts.
# Each [object] is sealed with its k_f and object_id: K_p, K_m and commit = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = k_f,
# salt = object_id, info = label, L = 32); chunk i of n = class.chunks seals content[i*CHUNK_PT ..]
# zero padded to CHUNK_PT under nonce 0^7 || u32_be(i) || u8(i = n - 1) and AD_c; fragment j is
# bytes [(j%4)*FRAG, (j%4+1)*FRAG) of chunk j/4. width, height and duration_ms are what the walker
# of the content's kind reports (the manifest must equal them); the preview is a canonical JPEG.
# manifest_plaintext is MP (65 488 B), manifest_blob = commit || ChaCha20-Poly1305(K_m, 0^12, AD_m, MP),
# manifest_hash = SHA-256(manifest_blob) = the descriptor's. A video's content ends with GHOST's mfra.
#
# [negative *] cases: start from the honest `object`, apply each `opN` in order, then run `step`;
# every step before the one named must pass, and that step must give `expect`.
#   flip_fragment j byte bit       XOR 1 << bit into byte `byte` of fragment j
#   swap_fragments j1 j2           exchange two fragments
#   swap_chunks i1 i2              exchange two chunks (all four fragments)
#   foreign_fragment j obj j2      fragment j := fragment j2 of the honest object `obj`
#   reseal_chunk i last            chunk i := its honest plaintext sealed with the given last flag
#   reseal_chunk_ad i oid kind     chunk i := its honest plaintext sealed with AD_c(oid, kind)
#   reseal_chunk_pad i at v        chunk i := its honest plaintext with byte `at` := v, sealed
#   rehash                         the hash list of MP := SHA-256 of the current fragments; reseal MP
#   manifest_set at hex            MP[at ..] := hex; reseal MP (same K_m, nonce 0)
#   manifest_flip byte bit         XOR a bit into the blob; the descriptor keeps the old hash
#   manifest_flip_rehash byte bit  XOR a bit into the blob; the descriptor names the new hash
#   key hex                        the reader opens with this K_f (the blob is not resealed)
#   expect field value             the descriptor's kind | view_once | class_code := value
#   truncate_class c               MP's class := c, content_len := min(content_len, cap(c)), the hashes
#                                  after F(c) := zero, only the first c.chunks chunks; reseal MP
# "Reseal MP" also sets the descriptor's manifest_hash to the new blob's. Steps: `open` (readerOpen:
# hash, commitment, tag, every §3.5 rule, agreement with the descriptor), `read i` (readerChunk in
# read mode: index range, fragment hashes, tag with the last flag of index n - 1 only, zero pad; a
# refused chunk exposes nothing), `validate` (every chunk in order, then the walked width, height
# and duration against the manifest's).
# MP offsets: m_version 0, kind 1, flags 2, class_code 3, object_id 4, content_len 20, width 28,
# height 30, duration_ms 32, preview_len 36, preview 38, hashes 32806.
# [separation] values are checks that cannot fail (another key derives another value); they are
# reported apart from the refusals (S0-6).
# [ladder]: the size STRIP_IMAGE re-encodes a W x H source to (D29, §8.2, Q37): the long edge is the
# largest of 512, 1 024 and 2 048 not above the source's (512 for a smaller source), the short edge
# max(16, 16 * round(long * short_src / long_src / 16)) rounding half up, at most the long edge, and the
# orientation kept; preview[W x H] is the same with the long edge 320 (S1's reading, §22.2).

[constants]
FRAG = 65536
TAG = 16
CHUNK_CT = 262144
CHUNK_PT = 262128
MANIFEST_PT = 65488
PREVIEW_OFFSET = 38
PREVIEW_MAX = 32768
HASHES_OFFSET = 32806
IMAGE_MAX_CONTENT = 1048512
MAX_CONTENT = 52428800
VIDEO_MAX_MS = 160000
DESCRIPTOR_FIXED = 86
MAX_CAPTION_BYTES = 1024

[labels]
payload = ghost/v1/media/payload
manifest = ghost/v1/media/manifest

ad_chunk = ghost/v1/media/ad/chunk
ad_manifest = ghost/v1/media/ad/manifest
op_id = ghost/v1/media/op
wrap = ghost/v1/wrap/media-file-key
